name: Beef Sunday Roast
assumptions: Recipe serves 4 people based on 8 slices of roast beef (~200g/person), 1kg potatoes, 500g carrots, 360g broccoli, and 12 Yorkshire puddings (3 per person).
Total time estimated from instructions: ~45 min oven roast + 20-25 min Yorkshire puddings + vegetable boiling time, rounded to nearest 15 min increment.
Plain flour classified as containing wheat (not gluten-free).
Milk and eggs explicitly listed, so dairy and egg allergens true; no tree nuts, peanuts, fish, shellfish, soy, or sesame in listed ingredients.
No gravy ingredients provided in list, so not factored into classifications despite mention in instructions.
instructions:
Cook the Broccoli and Carrots in a pan of boiling water until tender.

Roast the Beef and Potatoes in the oven for 45mins, the potatoes may need to be checked regularly to not overcook.

To make the Yorkshire puddings:
Heat oven to 230C/fan 210C/gas 8. Drizzle a little sunflower oil evenly into 2 x 4-hole Yorkshire pudding tins or a 12-hole non-stick muffin tin and place in the oven to heat through
To make the batter, tip 140g plain flour into a bowl and beat in four eggs until smooth. Gradually add 200ml milk and carry on beating until the mix is completely lump-free. Season with salt and pepper. Pour the batter into a jug, then remove the hot tins from the oven. Carefully and evenly pour the batter into the holes. Place the tins back in the oven and leave undisturbed for 20-25 mins until the puddings have puffed up and browned. Serve immediately.

Plate up and add the Gravy as desired.

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.assumptions: 8 typical roast beef slices from a 1.6-2kg joint; assumes roasted, lean+fat British beef cuts like topside or rib; ~100g per slice based on standard Sunday roast portions

ingredients.name: Broccoli
ingredients.assumptions: 12 medium broccoli florets; ~30g each after trimming, boiled until tender as per instructions

ingredients.name: Potatoes
ingredients.assumptions: 1 standard 1kg packet of roasting potatoes (e.g. Maris Piper), peeled or unpeeled, roasted in oven as per instructions; common UK packet size for Sunday roast

ingredients.name: Carrots
ingredients.assumptions: 1 standard 500g packet of carrots, peeled and boiled until tender as per instructions; typical UK fresh carrot packet size

ingredients.name: plain flour
ingredients.assumptions: Exactly 140g plain white flour as specified for Yorkshire pudding batter

ingredients.name: Eggs
ingredients.assumptions: 4 large eggs (UK medium-large ~50g each without shell); used in Yorkshire pudding batter

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.assumptions: Exactly 200ml semi-skimmed milk (density ~1.03g/ml) as specified for Yorkshire pudding batter

ingredients.name: sunflower oil
ingredients.assumptions: Drizzle of sunflower oil for 12 Yorkshire pudding tin holes; assumes ~2-3ml per hole (total ~30ml, density 0.92g/ml) to coat bottoms as per instructions; typical amount to prevent sticking without excess
